Aquasky Honored with the 24th Taichung Golden Hand Award

 

Aquasky Enterprise is honored to be among the 18 companies selected for the 24th Taichung Golden Hand Award. Hailed as the " Taiwan's Economic Oscar," this award is one of the most prestigious honors for outstanding manufacturing enterprises in Taichung Taiwan.

The award ceremony was grandly held on October 31 at the Taichung City Government Assembly Hall, where Aquasky recognized for excellence in operational management, technological innovation, and sustainable development.

This achievement affirms Aquasky’s outstanding in pressure tank engineering, manufacturing excellence, and global supply leadership, while highlighting Taichung’s growing competitiveness in high-value smart manufacturing.

Picture 1 : Frank Wang, Manager of Aquasky (second row, third from the left), representing the company at the award ceremony. (Source)

Picture 2 : Aquasky Enterprise – 24th Taichung Golden Hand Award Certificate of Merit (2025)

 

“Taiwan's Economic Oscar” – Recognizing Manufacturing Excellence

The Taichung Golden Hand Award was presented by Deputy Secretary-General Lin Yu-Hung (林育鴻) on behalf of Mayor Lu Shiow-yen (盧秀燕), who praised awardees for driving industrial upgrading through innovation and quality excellence.

Legislative Yuan Deputy Speaker Johnny Chiang Chi-chen also attended the ceremony, recognizing Taichung manufacturers for their resilience, technological capability, and global competitiveness - making “Made in Taichung” a trusted symbol of international manufacturing quality.

 

Precision Pressure Tank Technology Driving Global Markets

Founded in 1998 in Taichung, Taiwan, Aquasky has specialized in pressure tank design, development, and manufacturing, exporting products to more than 70 countries worldwide.

Aquasky provides comprehensive OEM/ODM solutions for:

• Residential and commercial water systems

• Reverse osmosis systems and booster pump applications

• HVAC, solar, thermal heater, and hydronic systems

• Liquid cooling pressure tanks for AI server cooling systems

• Customized diaphragm tank solutions

By integrating precision forming, advanced material engineering, and automated welding technologies, Aquasky delivers pressure tanks known for high durability, stable pressure control, and long service life across Asia, Europe, and North America.

 

Quality, Safety & International Certifications

Aquasky’s manufacturing facilities operate under strict international quality management and safety systems, including:

• ISO 9001 / ISO 14001

• NSF Certification

• CE / RoHS Compliance

• Pressure vessel safety standards

In addition, we also hold various regional certifications across different countries and continents, such as ACS, KC, and WaterMark. These certifications ensure that Aquasky pressure tanks meet the most stringent global requirements for safety, performance, and environmental protection.

 

Sustainability & Corporate Responsibility

Aquasky actively adopts low-emission coating processes, recyclable material usage, and energy-efficient production systems to minimize environmental impact while improving manufacturing efficiency.

The company also collaborates with local suppliers to build a sustainable industrial ecosystem and participates in environmental education and water conservation programs, reinforcing long-term commitment to ESG development.

 

Looking Ahead

Rooted in Taichung, Aquasky will continue to enhance pressure tank R&D, advance automated manufacturing capabilities, and expand its global OEM/ODM service network.

With sustainability embedded into operations, Aquasky is committed to delivering world-class pressure tank solutions and ensuring that “Made in Taichung” continues to shine in the global water systems industry.

If you have any questions about 24th Taichung golden hand award or Aquasky products, please feel free to contact us.

Email: frankwang@aquasky.com.tw

And thank you for your continued support.

Aquasky remains dedicated to providing safe, compliant, and high-quality water system solutions for global markets.
